items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s what Joe Piro, “Killer Joe,” used to say at the Palladium, in the mambo show.

ctx.x: ‘69. “Vaya” means go. That’s what Joe Piro, “Killer Joe,” used to say at the Palladium, in the mambo show. “Vaya” means go.
When I look at your... There are so many other important recordings, Palmas... But I’m seeing that there was a gap between ‘87, La Verdad, an ‘87 release, and then Sueño, ‘92.
